field.name: optionValue
field.description: Usage depends on enum type such as an ID format/mask

field.name: optionIndicator
field.description: Indicator flag with meaning depending on enum type

field.name: memberInfo
field.description: General info about the member, usage is specific to the enum group

view-entity.description: For getting EnumGroup members by enumGroupEnumId

field.name: statusColor
field.description: The color of the status by its meaning, a Quasar color name: grey-7 (draft, proposed), primary (in progress), warning (waiting), positive (done well), negative (ended badly) or info (informational). The status-bar element and the status chips read it through org.moqui.impl.StatusServices.get#StatusColors, which guesses one from the words of the status id when it is empty (IronStone style-guide §5.2). Not in Java Moqui.

field.name: statusTypeId
field.description: Optional. If specified uses status items with this type.

moqui.basic.StatusFlow.description: Default status flow across entire system.

field.name: isInitial
field.description: If true can be an initial status in this flow.

field.name: conditionExpression
field.description: Not currently supported, may be removed, issue with what is the context for the expression

relationship.description: No FK in order to allow arbitrary permissions (ie not pre-configured).

field.name: conversionOffset
field.description: The factor is multiplied first, then the offset is added. When converting in the reverse direction the offset is subtracted first, then divided by the factor.

field.name: rootEmailMessageId
field.description: For threaded messages, this points to the message that started the thread.

field.name: parentEmailMessageId
field.description: For threaded messages, this points to the previous message in the thread.

field.name: bodyText
field.description: The plain text variation of the body

field.name: emailTemplateId
field.description: For outgoing messages that came from an EmailTemplate.

field.name: emailAccountId
field.description: The EmailAccount the message is in, for the mail client

field.name: emailFolderId
field.description: The EmailFolder of its account; empty for a message in the Outbox (scheduled, held for undo, or failed to send)

field.name: emailIdentityId
field.description: The identity a draft is sent from

field.name: remoteUid
field.description: The IMAP UID in remoteFolderId, under that folder's remoteUidValidity

field.name: remoteFolderId
field.description: The folder the message is in on the server, which remoteUid belongs to: emailFolderId once the sync has made a local move there too (push#RemoteChanges), the folder it left until then; empty for a message kept only here

field.name: remoteUidl
field.description: The POP3 UIDL of a message fetched from a POP3 server

field.name: messageDate
field.description: The date the mail client sorts by: received for received mail, sent for sent mail, the last save of a draft, the time a scheduled message goes out

field.name: snippet
field.description: The start of the body as plain text, for the message list

field.name: messageSize
field.description: Bytes: the server's size, or the body and attachments of a local message

field.name: inReplyTo
field.description: The In-Reply-To header: the messageId of the parent

field.name: referencesHeader
field.description: The References header: message ids separated by spaces

field.name: snoozedThruDate
field.description: Hidden from the inbox until then

field.name: scheduledSendDate
field.description: When a scheduled (ES_SCHEDULED) message goes out: the time chosen, or the end of the undo-send hold

field.name: sendError
field.description: Why the last send failed; the message waits in the Outbox for a retry

field.name: storeFolder
field.description: Defaults to INBOX

field.name: smtpUsername
field.description: When set, SMTP signs in as this user (with smtpPassword, else mailPassword) instead of mailUsername, for a provider whose outgoing server has its own sign-in; empty for the same sign-in as the store

field.name: smtpPassword
field.description: The password of smtpUsername, encrypted; empty for mailPassword. Not used without smtpUsername.

field.name: webBaseUrl
field.description: Full base URL, scheme and host, for links in emails sent through this server, such as https://shop.example.com. Used when the EmailTemplate has no webHostName; empty for the conf webapp's host. Store emails use ProductStore.storeDomain.

field.name: allowedToDomains
field.description: Comma separated list of domain names to allow (like: moqui.org, dejc.com), matched by ends with; if no value specified all domains allowed

field.name: authTypeEnumId
field.description: How SMTP and the store sign in: EatPassword (mailUsername and mailPassword; the default) or EatOAuth2 (XOAUTH2 as mailUsername with an access token from oauthRefreshToken, org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.start#OAuthSignIn)

field.name: oauthProviderEnumId
field.description: The EmailOAuthProvider an EatOAuth2 server signs in with

field.name: oauthRefreshToken
oauthSignInDate
field.description: When the user last signed in with the provider

entity.description: The current OAuth access token of an EatOAuth2 EmailServer, shared by the servers of a cluster so one refreshes it at a time (EmailServer locked for update) and a refresh token the provider rotates is not lost. Not on EmailServer, which is cached and exported. Written and deleted by the framework only.

field.name: refreshTokenDigest
field.description: The digest of the refresh token the access token came from; a row of another refresh token (a new sign-in) is not used

entity.description: An OAuth 2.0 provider a mail account signs in with instead of a password (docs/Mail-OAuth.md; EmailClientServices.start#OAuthSignIn, XOAUTH2 for IMAP and SMTP): its endpoints, the scopes it asks for and those that must be granted, how the ID token names the address, how discover#EmailServer knows its addresses, and the servers of an account made with it. The deployment's own OAuth client, registered at the provider, comes from the properties (or environment variables) {propertyPrefix}_client_id and {propertyPrefix}_client_secret, else from clientId and clientSecret here; with neither, or disabled, the provider is not configured and the wizard does not offer it. {tenant} in the URLs and the issuer is {propertyPrefix}_tenant, else tenant, else common; {tenantid} in the issuer is any tenant.

field.name: revokeUrl
field.description: Where a refresh token is revoked (RFC 7009); empty when the provider has none, and the token is then only deleted here

field.name: userInfoUrl
field.description: Read with the access token for the address when the token response has no ID token

field.name: scope
field.description: The scopes asked for, space separated

field.name: popScope
field.description: The scopes asked for too, and to be granted, when the account reads its mail over POP3 (Microsoft: POP.AccessAsUser.All; Google's mail scope covers POP), space separated

field.name: mailScope
field.description: The scopes that must be granted for mail; a sign-in where the user left one out is refused

field.name: authParams
field.description: More query parameters of the authorization request, such as access_type=offline&prompt=consent

field.name: refreshParams
field.description: More form parameters of a refresh; {scope} is the scope

field.name: issuer
field.description: The ID token's iss

field.name: addressClaims
field.description: The ID token (or user info) claims that may hold the address, comma separated, the first present wins; an email_verified of false refuses it

field.name: addressDomains
field.description: The address domains of the provider's own mail, comma separated, for discover#EmailServer

field.name: hostSuffixes
field.description: Server host names (or their suffixes) that are the provider's, comma separated

field.name: mxSuffixes
field.description: MX host suffixes of a domain whose mail is at the provider (a company domain), comma separated

field.name: storeProtocol
field.description: imaps (the default) or imap

field.name: popHost
field.description: The POP3 server of an account made with the provider to read its mail over POP3 (start#OAuthSignIn storeProtocol pop3); empty when the provider has none

field.name: popProtocol
field.description: pop3s (the default) or pop3

entity.description: A mail account of a user or an organization: the user's Internal account (EakInternal, one per user, made on first use, with no server and no EmailMessage rows: internal messages live with the app, such as Mantle's CommunicationEvent), an account at a hosted domain (EakHosted), an external IMAP or POP account (EakExternal) or a shared account with members (EakShared). The connection is the EmailServer.

field.name: ownerUserId
field.description: The user whose account it is; the owner may do everything

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: For an organization's shared account, the organization's party; its users reach it through EmailAccountUser rows

field.name: ownsEmailServer
field.description: Y when the server was made for this account, so the account's settings change and remove it; a server shared with others (SYSTEM) is never changed through an account

field.name: syncWindowDays
field.description: How far back the sync reads; empty for all mail

field.name: recordFilingEnumId
field.description: Whether received mail is filed on the records of the parties it matches (ErfAllMatches) or only when a user links it (ErfLinkedOnly); by kind when empty: external accounts file only what is linked, hosted and shared accounts every match

field.name: syncIntervalMinutes
field.description: How often the sync job syncs the account; empty for the email-client sync-interval in the conf (5 minutes)

field.name: syncLockedUntil
field.description: A sync of the account holds it until then (sync#EmailAccount), so no two run at once, on this server or another; the lock of a server that stopped ends then

entity.description: A member of a shared account (or another user an account is shared with) and what they may do: EapRead reads the mail and marks it read, EapSend also sends from the account and files its mail (drafts, flags, folders, labels, snooze, archive, trash), EapManage also changes the account, its members, identities, folders, labels and out-of-office.
An address an account sends as, with its name, reply-to and signature.

field.name: useForReplies
field.description: The signature goes on replies and forwards too

entity.description: A folder of an account. Every account but the Internal one has an Inbox, Drafts, Sent, Archive, Junk and Trash folder, made with it; the sync maps the server's folders onto them by kind. The remote fields are the sync's IMAP state; unreadCount and totalCount are the server's counts at the last sync (the services count the local messages).

field.name: folderPath
field.description: The server's name for the folder, such as INBOX or [Gmail]/Sent Mail; empty for a folder only kept here

field.name: remoteUidNext
field.description: The sync's next UID to read: every message from it on is new

field.name: subscribed
field.description: Y when the sync reads the folder; N leaves it as it is here (EmailClientServices.update#EmailFolder; the Inbox is always read)

field.name: kindByUser
field.description: Y when a user chose the folder's kind (update#EmailFolder): the sync keeps it, and maps no other server folder to that kind by its special use or name

field.name: delimiter
field.description: The server's hierarchy delimiter in folderPath

field.name: lastFlagScanDate
field.description: When the sync last read the flags of each message, on a server without CONDSTORE

field.name: remoteRemovedDate
field.description: When the folder was no longer on the server: its local messages are kept, and it is synced again if it comes back

entity.description: A local change of an account's mail waiting to be made on its IMAP server (push#RemoteChanges). The sync (sync#EmailAccount) applies them in the order made, at the start and the end of each session and, with the email-client sync-push-now in the conf on, right after the change commits. One that cannot be made now (the server cannot be reached, the message has no UID yet) waits for the next session; one that fails ten times is dropped with an error logged. So a local change is not lost while the server is away.

field.name: changeType
field.description: flags, move, labels, keywords, delete, sent (an APPEND to Sent), createFolder or renameFolder

field.name: emailMessageId
field.description: The message; a deleted one's row is gone, so its place on the server is kept here too

field.name: emailFolderId
field.description: The folder of a folder change

field.name: remoteFolderId
field.description: For a delete: the folder the message was in on the server

field.name: messageId
field.description: The Message-ID, to find a message whose UID is not known

field.name: changeJson
field.description: flags: the flags changed ({isRead, isFlagged, isAnswered}); keywords: {add, remove}; renameFolder: {oldName}

entity.description: A file of a message, its content at a resource location (a DbResource file for mail the client stores, under dbresource://email/).

field.name: contentId
field.description: The Content-ID an inline part is referred to by (cid:)

entity.description: A user's rule for received mail: conditionsJson is a list of {field, operator, value} (field from, to, cc, subject, body, hasAttachment, listId, size, or header with a header name; operator contains, is, matches (a regular expression) or startsWith, and greater or less for the size), matched all or any by matchAllEnumId; actionsJson a list of {action, value} (moveToFolder, addLabel, markRead, flag, forwardTo, delete, markSpam, stopProcessing; or an app's action: an EmailRuleAction enumeration whose enumCode is the action and whose optionValue names the service that does it, as Mantle's createRequest). Rules run in sequenceNum order on the account they name, or on all of the owner's when emailAccountId is empty, when the sync stores new Inbox mail and on demand (EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules); stopProcessing ends the run.

field.name: emailAccountId
field.description: Empty for all of the owner's accounts

entity.description: An account's automatic reply: sent by the receiver while enabled and between the dates, once per sender in replyOncePerDays; internalBodyHtml, when set, to senders of the user's own organization (its users, the domains of its hosted and shared accounts, and internalDomains). replyAudienceEnumId says who gets it: everyone (EraEveryone, the default), internal senders and the owner's contacts (EraContacts), or internal senders only (EraInternal).

field.name: replyAudienceEnumId
field.description: Who gets the reply; empty for everyone. A contact is a sender the hook service names (EmailClientServices.filter#ContactAddresses: the email_contact_service property, else the owner's theme value STRT_EMAIL_CONTACT_SERVICE); with no hook every sender is one.

field.name: internalDomains
field.description: More domains whose senders are internal, comma separated in lower case (example.com,example.org), beside the users of this system and the domains of the hosted and shared accounts.

entity.description: When an account's automatic reply last went to a sender (the address in lower case), so it goes once per sender in replyOncePerDays (EmailClientServices.send#OutOfOfficeReplies). Storing the automatic reply clears them, so a new one goes to everyone again.

field.name: emailMessageId
field.description: The message the last reply answered

entity.description: Canned text for the composer: a user's own, or shared with the members of userGroupId.

field.name: userGroupId
field.description: Shared with this group's members

entity.description: A user's saved search, a rail entry: queryText is the search line with its operators.

field.name: replyToAddresses
field.description: Comma separated list of reply to email addresses

field.name: ccAddresses
field.description: Comma separated list of CC email addresses

field.name: bccAddresses
field.description: Comma separated list of BCC email addresses

field.name: attachmentLocation
field.description: ResourceFacade location for attachment content or screen (if screenRenderMode specified)

field.name: screenPath
field.description: Alternative to attachmentLocation as a location for the screen rendered on its own. If specified is used to determine the screen by path from the root screen looked up using the webappName and webHostName values from EmailTemplate.

field.name: screenRenderMode
field.description:
Used to determine the MIME/content type, and which screen render template to use. Can be used to generate XSL:FO that is transformed to a PDF and attached to the email with screenRenderMode=xsl-fo.
If empty the content at attachmentLocation will be sent over without rendering and its MIME type will be based on its extension.

field.name: forEachIn
field.description: A Groovy expression that evaluates to a Collection in the context to iterate over and add an attachment for each. If entries are Map objects puts all entries in context for each (pushed/isolated context), otherwise puts Collection entry in 'forEachEntry' field. Only applicable if screenRenderMode is specified so that there is a render of the attachment.

field.name: attachmentCondition
field.description: Optional Groovy expression evaluated as a boolean, if specified and evaluates to false attachment will be skipped.

field.name: serverPort
field.description: Defaults to 631

field.name: printerName
field.description: Leave empty to use default printer on print server

field.name: orientation
field.description: portrait or landscape; empty for the print queue's default

field.name: colorMode
field.description: color or monochrome; empty for the print queue's default
